title: Columbia top 80 researchers — ranked nodes, 2021–2024
description: One row per selected stable OpenAlex author ID, including isolates. Rank by distinct 2021–2024 snapshot works with a Columbia parent or included child affiliation on the specific authorship, descending, then author ID ascending. Profile display names. total_snapshot_work_count includes all of the author’s works in this snapshot and period, independently of their own affiliation. All work types; neither count is lifetime.
code:
from collections import Counter
from itertools import combinations
sw = sql(base + 'SELECT DISTINCT work_id,author_id,is_columbia FROM period_bylines JOIN selected USING(author_id)')
verified = Counter()
for _, group in sw.groupby('work_id'):
    verified.update(combinations(sorted(set(group.author_id)),2))
assert verified == {(a,b):int(n) for a,b,n in ed.itertuples(index=False,name=None)}
assert sw.groupby('author_id').work_id.nunique().to_dict() == nd.set_index('author_id').total_snapshot_work_count.to_dict()
assert sw[sw.is_columbia].groupby('author_id').work_id.nunique().to_dict() == nd.set_index('author_id').columbia_affiliated_work_count.to_dict()
